meaning:
"Matsor", a name for Egypt
Another spelling of mits.ra.yim (מִצְרַ֫יִם "Egypt" H4714G)
This name means siege, entrenchment

elsewhere.note: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”
The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
